criteria.note: Self surface covered behaviourally by check-hardness-inventory.mjs self mode (in-place spawn, cwd at repo root, in-repo fixture); probe-hooks.mjs stays consumer-scoped with the reason recorded. Both halves ship. AC reworded from the first normalisation, which had over-committed to naming probe-hooks.mjs as the vehicle; rewording recorded on the issue.
No tracked-state mutation; every write confined to a gitignored pid-scoped sandbox, and any fixture path outside it is refused rather than written.
Gate-wired under a name distinct from the template run (parity gates are keyed by name; a duplicate would mask a failing self run). Measured ~200ms; L2 summary reports 233ms.
Planted defect flips red with 'ceremony regression detected'; negative control green. Also reproduced on the real surface: four live exit-1 hooks found before the fix, all green after.
Surface matrix with a row per check plus an explicit known-uncovered-cells list.

settings.json INTERSECT self manifest asserted; ADVISORY floor fails any ADVISORY entry whose source contains process.exit(2), with promotedBy as the only escape hatch and the env var verified present in source.
Undeclared hook fails; an emptied hooks:[] manifest still fails rather than passing vacuously. lib.mjs/hooks.mjs excluded in self mode only.

Hook runs against its own lib.mjs (sentinel export the template lib lacks), and expectStderr pins the verdict to the intended branch. Empirically: removing an export from .claude/hooks/lib.mjs reddens 10 self hooks, so this harness would have caught #2324 where the template-staged model could not.

Fixture paths outside the sandbox and traversal escapes are refused without writing; path-only targets hashed before/after; cleanup asserted on the failing path and mutation-verified (disabling the rmSync flips it red).

Floor of 10 observed asserted. Lowered from 12 during review: pre-edit-ssot-guard and enforce-gate-before-pr became declared-only because probing them consumed a developer's one-shot .arbiter/ssot-bypass token and read the live gate-pass marker respectively.
